note: Both sets correctly capture all nine Table 5.5-4 bandpass values with supporting quotes and no invented facts. Set B is slightly more faithful: it labels the 0.975–1.8 µm entry as an IR bandpass (Set A's bare 'bandpass' is vague) and adds mode conditions (UV/Visible/IR mode) to the three claims where the table's science/guide context matters. Set A omits these conditions entirely, so its claims are marginally less complete, though neither set records the science/guide qualifiers explicitly.
